verdict: Revised after orchestrator review: muted matte crown gauze, localized stain, and readable face in the actual cower pose; final native and production scene sheets reviewed.

checks.skin: Face and exposed arms follow the same palette, including tone 5. Khaki trousers remain clothes; normalized trouser paint looks dark in the standalone comparison but takes the production person tint.
checks.dressings: Head cloth is authored albedo (class 5 / alpha 219), roughness 1, metallic 0, emission [0,0,0], on the same body material as skin. Crown coverage replaces the thin halo stripe; smooth paint replaces repeating limb contour rings. A small temple stain replaces a continuous red border.
checks.binding: Neutral game template fit removes 104 unrelated seam joins from the initial cut-source fit; final sources have zero unrelated joins and zero open edges.
checks.headwear: Head wraps and rear hair inspected in every native sheet. Existing named caps retained; Marcus checked from front and reverse game-camera azimuth.
checks.weapons: The four converted residents are unarmed. Both Marcus instances retain live pistol muzzles through the unified weapon path; no baked/box weapon added.
checks.rests: Standing source bind is restored before production story clips. Old and new source-only cushions are removed by the same production restoreStanding path. Lying comparison uses 120/400 px longest projected span to avoid clipping.
checks.faces: Bandaged source declares a 0.95-radian cower head lift so eyes and skin remain visible under the fringe in L6 light; other poses are unchanged. Both skin tones and front/back at 120/400 px reviewed on all four renderer/tier combinations.
checks.states: Actual four healthy, four living turned and four frozen corpses asserted; close sheets inspected for dressing/colour/eye retention.
